home.hero.eyebrow: The official Laravel community of Bangladesh
home.hero.title: Laravel developers of Bangladesh, together since 2012
home.hero.lead: Laravel Bangladesh brings together more than 21,000 developers, engineers, artisans and enthusiasts. We organise meetups and workshops, share talks and resources, and help members learn from each other and find work.
home.hero.mark: Laravel in front of the National Martyrs’ Memorial
home.community.title: Run by the community, for the community
home.community.lead: Laravel Bangladesh started in 2012 as a small group of developers sharing what they were learning. Today it is the largest Laravel community in the country, organised by volunteers and open to anyone who works with Laravel or wants to.

about.title: About
about.hero.title: The Laravel community of Bangladesh since 2012
about.hero.lead: Laravel Bangladesh is the official community of Laravel developers, engineers, artisans and enthusiasts in Bangladesh. What began in 2012 as a small group of developers has grown to more than 21,000 members who learn, build and hire together.
about.manifesto.title: What we do
about.manifesto.1.title: Meetups and workshops
about.manifesto.1.body: Regular in-person meetups in Dhaka and other cities, along with hands-on workshops. Talks are given by community members, from first-time speakers to senior engineers.
about.manifesto.2.title: Knowledge sharing
about.manifesto.2.body: Talks are recorded and shared with the community together with slides and notes. Discussion happens in English and Bangla, whichever is more comfortable.
about.manifesto.3.title: Careers and connections
about.manifesto.3.body: Members find collaborators, mentors, clients and jobs through the community. Companies use it to find Laravel talent in Bangladesh.
about.night.title: What to expect at a meetup
about.night.1.title: Registration and networking
about.night.1.body: Check in, meet other members and settle in before the talks begin.
about.night.2.title: Talks and sessions
about.night.2.body: Around five talks or sessions on Laravel, PHP and related tools, each followed by questions from the audience.
about.night.3.title: Open discussion
about.night.3.body: Time to continue conversations, ask for help with a problem and connect with speakers and other attendees.
about.who.title: Who is part of the community
about.who.1: Developers and engineers who build with Laravel and PHP in Bangladesh, or who are learning to.
about.who.2: Students and career changers starting out in web development.
about.who.3: Companies, agencies and freelancers who work with Laravel and want to hire or collaborate locally.
about.join.title: How to take part
about.join.1.title: Create an account
about.join.1.body: Log in with your email. We send a code or magic link, so there is no password to remember. A new email address creates your account, and you can add a passkey afterwards for faster sign-in.
about.join.2.title: Register for an event
about.join.2.body: Browse upcoming meetups and workshops and register in one step.
about.join.3.title: Get involved
about.join.3.body: Propose a talk, add yourself to the directory or volunteer to help organise. The community is run by its members.
about.cities.title: Across Bangladesh
about.cities.body: The community began in Dhaka, where most meetups are held. Members now join from cities across Bangladesh and from abroad, in person when they can and online when they cannot.
about.cities.list: Dhaka · Chattogram · Sylhet · Khulna · Rajshahi · Rangpur
about.cta.title: Join the community
about.cta.lead: See what is coming up, or log in to register for the next event.
